senses.gloss: Suśānta = Śiva: VII, 9524.
Suśārada = Śiva (1000 names^2).

Suśarman^1, king of the Trigartas. § 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6989 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).-§ 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 30, 971 (rājā Trigartānāṃ), 984, 992, 998; 31, 1003; 32, 1059 (rukmarathaḥ), 1060 (rājā Trigartānāṃ), 1063, 1064; 33, 1070 (Traigartaḥ), †1073 (Trigartādhipatiḥ), 1075, 1078 (Trigartena), 1089, 1090, 1092 (bhrātṛbhiḥ saha), 1094, 1096, 1101, 1102, 1103, 1105, 1107, 1111, 1112, 1114, 1118, 1123, 1124; 34, 1129, 1130, 1131 (headed by S., the Trigartas carry away the cattle of Virāṭa; a great battle ensues; at last S. is defeated and made captive by Bhīmasena, but set free by Yudhishṭhira).---§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 83.--§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 45^17, 1728, 1729, 1730 (fought with Cekitāna); 51, 2108 (in the army of Duryodhana).--§ 583 (do.): VI, 75, 3296 (Prasthalādhipaḥ, in the krauñcavyūha of Bhīshma). --§ 584 (do.): VI, 82^2, 3577, 3580; 84, 3744, 3747 (engaged in battle with Arjuna); 86, 3834 (ºādīn rājñaḥ, defeated by Arjuna).--§ 585 (do.): VI, 96, 4339 (attacked Arjuna).--§ 586 (do.): VI, 102, 4651; 104, 4730, 4731, 4736 (pierced Arjuna and Kṛshṇa).--§ 587 (do.): VI, 108, 5008 (ºpramukhā nṛpāḥ, in the rear of Duryodhana's army); 113, 5287, 5288 (attacked Bhīmasena and Arjuna); 114, 5292, 5299, 5324 (defeated by Arjuna).-§ 590 (Droṇābhishekap.): VI, 14, 531 (fought with Senāpati [i.e. Dhṛshṭadyumna?]).--§ 591 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 17, 691 (Trigartaḥ Prasthalādhipaḥ, with his brothers among the Saṃśaptakas who swore either to slay Arjuna or die themselves), 712 (bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ).--§ 592 (do.): VII, 28, 1227 (do.), 1228 (do.), 1232, 1234, 1235 (encounter with Arjuna).--§ 603 (Nārāyaṇāstramokshap.): VII, 193, 8910 (when Droṇa had fallen S. fled with the Saṃśaptakas). --§ 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 27, 1079 (Trigartarājaḥ), 1085, 1087, 1101 (among the Saṃśaptakas, fought with Arjuna and was wounded).--§ 608 (do.): VIII, 53, 2567, 2569, 2592 (employed the Sauparṇa weapon), 2597 (Arjuna's encounter with the Saṃśaptakas); 95, 4972 (Saṃśaptakāvaśishṭena balena mahatā vṛtaḥ).--§ 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 27, 1473, 1483, 1487, 1488, 1489 (is slain by Arjuna). Cf. Prasthalādhipa, Prasthalādhipati, Rukmaratha, Traigarta, Trigarta, Trigartādhipati, Trigartarāj, Trigartarāja, Trigartarājan.

Suśarman^2, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 570 (Sainyaniryāṇap.): V, 151, 5163 (in the army of Yudhishṭhira, B. has Sudharmā). --§ 587 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 116, 5402, 5403 (fought with Citrasena); 118, 5555. Cf. next.
Suśarman^3, a Pāñcāla prince. § 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 56, 2735 (attacked by Karṇa).
Suśobhanā, daughter of the frog king Āyu(s) and wife of king Parikshit of Ayodhyā. § 461 (Vāmadevacarita): III, 162, ††13173.
Suśravā, daughter of a Vidarbha king. § 156 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, ††3770 (Vaidarbhīṃ, wife of Jayatsena).
Suśruta, a son of Viśvāmitra. § 721b (Viśvāmitrop.): XIII, 4, 254.
Susaha = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Susāman, a brahman. § 286 (Rājasūyikap.): II, 33, 1238 (Dhanañjayānām ṛshabhaḥ, acted as sāmaga at the rājasūya of Yudhishṭhira).
Susaṅkshepa = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Susaṅkula, a king. § 279 (Arjuna): II, 27, 1020 (vanquished by Arjuna on his digvijaya).
Susaraṇa, Sushāḍha = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Susheṇa^1, a serpent. § 67 (Sarpasattra): I, 57, 2157 (of Dhṛtarāshṭra's race).

Susheṇa^2, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2732.--§ 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4546.-§ 571 (Ulūkadūtāgamanap.): V, 160, †5531 (the same?, º-Śitrāyudhanāganakraṃ, sc. purushodadhiṃ, i.e. the army of Duryodhana); 161, †5574--75 (repetition of v. 5531, omitted in C.).--§ 581 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 64, 2837 (among fourteen sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra who attacked Bhīmasena), 2843 (slain by Bhīmasena).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 127, 5178 (attacked Bhīmasena), 5204 (slain by Bhīmasena).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 7, †206 (tavātmajaḥ, i.e. Dhṛtarāshṭra's, still alive). Cf. Susheṇa^7.
Susheṇa^3, son of the elder Parikshit. § 154 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3744.
Susheṇa^4, a prince. § 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6996 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).
Susheṇa^5, son of Jamadagni. § 396 (Jamadagni): III, 116, 10180.
Susheṇa^6, a monkey. § 535 (Setubandhana): III, 283, 16270 (the father-in-law of Vālin, came to Rāma with a crore of monkeys).--§ 541 (Indrajidvadha): III, 289, 16468.
Susheṇa^7, various Kuru warriors. § 593 (Abhimanyuvadhap.): VII, 37, 1610, 1614 (slain by Abhimanyu).-§ 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 11, 419 (in the makar-avyūha of Karṇa).--§ 610 (Śalyap.): IX, 6, 294.

Susheṇa^8, son of Karṇa. § 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 48, 2251 (Karṇasya putrau…Sºḥ Satyasenaś ca), 2257, 2264, 2265, 2267, 2269, 2270, 2271, 2272 (fought with Bhīmasena and Nakula); 49, 2329 (ºṃ Satyasenañ ca, pierced by Yudhishṭhira); 66, 3311 (protected Karṇa); 75, †3812 (Karṇasya putraṃ), †3817 (Uttamaujas cut off the head of S.).--§ 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 10, 481 (Karṇaputrau…Sºḥ Satyasenaś ca), 489, 490, 492, 495, 500, 504, 506 (fought with Nakula who slew him). Cf. Karṇaputra, Karṇātmaja.
Susheṇa^9 = Kṛshṇa: XII, 1511.--Do.^10 = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Susheṇamātṛ (“the mother of Susheṇa^3”). § 619 (Strīvilāpap.): XI, 21, †614 (i.e. the wife of Karṇa).
Susnāta = Mahāpurusha (Mahāpurushastava).
Susthala, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 273 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 14, 590 (among the people who fled from fear of Jarāsandha).
Susvapna = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Susvara, a Suparṇa, son of Garuḍa. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 101, 3599.
